punchline: The belief that adults cannot grow new brain cells was dropped, according to Perlmutter.
thirty_sec: Scientists long believed you were stuck with the brain cells you were born with. Neurologist David Perlmutter writes that the memory region, the hippocampus, can make new neurons in adults, helped by a protein called BDNF. He says exercise, fasting, omega-3 and sleep can raise it. Part of the evidence is from animals, and the human extent is debated.
